header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH BENCH AT SUKKUR
For Petitioner : Mr. Sheeraz Fazal, Advocate
For Respondents : M/s Ali Raza Balouch & Israr Ahmed
body: Andan Iqbal Chaudhry J.- The petitioner applied for the post of ASI in the Police Department on the Shaheed Quota and was selected. However, upon the requisite medical screening test, he was found to be infected with the Hepatitis “B” virus. Therefore his selection was withdrawn. The petitioner‟s case was then taken-up by the Recruitment Board on 26.06.2024, which endorsed the withdrawal of selection.

Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is no longer infected with the Hepatitis “B” virus and prays for a rescreening. However, since the recruitment process for year 2024 has since been completed, we are not inclined to re-open the same for that would be discrimination against other candidates who were similarly rejected. If the petitioner is no longer infected, he will be free to apply once again under the Shaheed Quota as and when fresh vacancies are advertised. Learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned AAG agree with that proposition. Petition is disposed of in said terms.
